item.text: Both reference hashes matched when flyers followed the listed waypoints all the way to the keep. Those segments total 2,800 centi-tiles, so I used that length instead of the stated 2,600. The first strategy trials also showed early air leaks, and I’m testing flak placement across seeds.

item.text:
Created [index.html](./index.html) as the sole deliverable. Both simulation self-checks matched exactly: `82a5353d` and `2e8858d7`. The matching engine uses the flyer waypoints’ actual length of 2,800 centi-tiles.

The strategy combines overlapping cannon coverage with central flak batteries and selects splash targets by effective damage and kill potential. It averaged **41.94 waves across ten non-42 seeds**, including five held out from tuning. Seed 42 scored **41.53**, with the keep falling at tick **1681**.

The replay, controls, WebGL HUD, combat effects, keep collapse, and synthesized audio are implemented. I opened the finished file in Chromium and verified scrubbing, Re-fire, speed persistence, and fall desaturation. Repeated scrubs reproduced the same rendered scene. I did not measure frame rate or verify audio by listening.
